meta.sparse: TfidfVectorizer() defaults on the full Wikipedia pages; score = cosine of the TF-IDF vectors; m = query terms present in the page
meta.mean: all-MiniLM-L6-v2, page vector = renormalized mean of its passage embeddings (as in the corpus atlas); score = cosine
meta.passage: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 over sentence-aligned passages of at most 60 words; a page scores as its best passage, t = that passage
meta.rank: where the query's intended page (target) landed under each method, 1 = top
